notes: v327 — TWO releases in one push. (A) POINTER for native generation 52 (APK v71, versionName 1.44 / versionCode 46), the native half of WIDGET-FROZEN-AGAIN (web half = web 325): SessionRecord.syncFromWeb gains the re-anchor gate — a non-forced sync for the same session, both sides live, carrying a bank of at most 60 s while starting its segment LATER than the segment the record counts from, is refused (applied=false) when the record's own derivation is >5 min ahead; the caller's adoption converges the stale web lifetime onto the record. (B) INSPECTION-MODE-14-DAY (owner Nov 5, 2026, named mid-inspection at a real roadside stop, specified from his Motive screen recording, amended twice): the PTI module's DOT Inspection Mode is rebuilt in Motive's shape. The entry card reads 'Inspect logs for previous 14 days + today — tap Begin Inspection and hand your phone to the officer', with ONE primary Begin Inspection button and a quiet Send door (the same 15 days of summaries as one PDF through MetPdf). Begin opens the officer flow: one full-page SUMMARY sheet per day for the previous 14 days + today (15 sheets; a day with no inspection says so on its own sheet), moved day to day by swipe or arrows — each inspection shown as date-sheet + pre/post + time + odometer + ONE result line (All items OK, or the defects named with severity) + signed. Never the item-by-item checklist; no HOS pages (not an ELD). AMENDMENT 2 (his words: 'inspection mode doesn't need a driver to put in a pin... Nobody does that'): the v165 PIN gate is REMOVED entirely — Begin is one tap, Exit is one tap, no code anywhere; a stored pinHash from the v165 days is never read again. The window widens from today+13 to today+14 per his 'previous 14 days + today'. Proof: tools/inspection-mode-v327-test.js 52/52 (window, summary lines, pager incl. clamping, one-tap in/out, Send lines, PIN absence); neighbouring PTI suites' failure sets identical to the pre-change baseline.
